```{r, fig.width = 8, fig.height = 12}
library(gprofiler2)
library(ggplot2)

load('/nfs/home/students/t.tabanli/artifical_meat_deconv/sig_dwls_messmer_recreated_counts/Sig.RData')

# option 2
gene_sets <- lapply(colnames(Sig), function(ct) {
  vals <- Sig[, ct]^0.1
  vals <- vals[vals > 0.3]
  names(vals)
})
names(gene_sets) <- colnames(Sig)

# option 1
cell_type <- colnames(Sig)[max.col(Sig, ties.method = "first")]
gene_sets  <- split(rownames(Sig), cell_type)


# GO enrichment per cell type (gprofiler2 handles bovine Ensembl IDs natively)
go_sources <- c("GO:MF", "GO:CC", "GO:BP")

go_results <- lapply(names(gene_sets), function(ct) {
  res_list <- lapply(go_sources, function(src) {
    res <- gost(query       = gene_sets[[ct]],
                organism    = "btaurus",
                sources     = src,
                significant = TRUE)$result
    if (is.null(res) || nrow(res) == 0) return(NULL)
    res$cell_type <- ct
    res$go_cat    <- src
    head(res[order(res$p_value), ], 2)
  })
  do.call(rbind, res_list)
})

top <- do.call(rbind, go_results)
top$log10p <- -log10(top$p_value)

ggplot(top, aes(x = log10p,
                y = reorder(term_name, log10p),
                fill = go_cat)) +
  geom_col() +
  facet_wrap(~ cell_type, scales = "free_y", ncol = 2) +
  labs(x = "-log10(p)", y = NULL, fill = "GO category") +
  theme_minimal()

```

Sig %>% as.data.frame() %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "cell_type", values_to = "value") %>%

  geom_violin() +

colMeans(Sig == 0) %>% as.data.frame() %>% rownames_to_column("cell_type") %>%
  rename(sparsity_mean = ".") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = cell_type, y = sparsity_mean)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity") + theme_minimal() + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust = 1))

rowSums(Sig > 0) %>% hist(main = "Cell Type Specificity", xlab = "Number of Celltypes the gene has > 0", ylab = "Freq. of Genes")

 cor(Sig, method = "spearman") %>%
    pheatmap::pheatmap()

```{r, fig.width=30}
library(fgsea)
library(org.Bt.eg.db)
library(AnnotationDbi)
library(GO.db)
library(tidytext)
library(ggh4x)

# Build GO gene sets from btaurus annotation
go_anno <- AnnotationDbi::select(
  org.Bt.eg.db,
  keys     = keys(org.Bt.eg.db, keytype = "ENSEMBL"),
  columns  = c("ENSEMBL", "GOALL", "ONTOLOGYALL"),
  keytype  = "ENSEMBL"
) %>% filter(!is.na(GOALL))

make_go_sets <- function(ont) {
    sub <- go_anno[go_anno$ONTOLOGYALL == ont, ]
    lapply(split(sub$ENSEMBL, sub$GOALL), unique)
  }


go_sets <- list(
  "GO:BP" = make_go_sets("BP")
  #"GO:MF" = make_go_sets("MF"),
  #"GO:CC" = make_go_sets("CC")
)

# GSEA per cell type, using Sig column as ranked score
rel_score <- function(ct) {
    #others <- setdiff(colnames(Sig), ct)
    #log2((Sig[, ct] + 1e-6) / (rowMeans(Sig[, others]) + 1e-6))
  Sig[, ct]^0.05
}

gsea_results <- lapply(colnames(Sig), function(ct) {
  ranked <- sort(rel_score(ct), decreasing = TRUE)

  res_list <- lapply(names(go_sets), function(src) {
    res <- fgsea(pathways    = go_sets[[src]],
                 stats       = ranked,
                 minSize     = 10,
                 maxSize     = 500,
                 scoreType   = "pos",
                 nPermSimple = 10000)
    res$cell_type <- ct
    res <- res[!is.na(res$padj), ]
    if (nrow(res) == 0) return(NULL)
    head(res[order(res$padj, res$size), ], 10)
  })
  do.call(rbind, res_list)
})

top <- do.call(rbind, gsea_results)

top$term_name <- mapIds(GO.db, keys = top$pathway,
                        column = "TERM", keytype = "GOID")

top %>%
  filter(padj < 0.05) %>%
  mutate(log10p = -log10(padj),
         term_name = reorder_within(term_name, log10p, cell_type)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = log10p, y = term_name)) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_y_reordered() +
  facet_wrap(~ cell_type, scales = "free_y", ncol = 4) +
  labs(x = "-log10(padj)", y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal()

```
